headline: NguyenThanhNhan surges into ARC-2 gold at 16th

sections.text: NguyenThanhNhan gained 13.89 points to reach 65.97, climbing from 30th to 16th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
That move carries the team into the 16 gold places, where it now sits on the cutoff score.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
